scenes.narration: Every Ryzen 7 at today's price, ranked by gaming value.
The Ryzen 7 5700X costs one hundred ninety-four euros, eight cores on AM4. Stay to the end, one price makes no sense.
The Ryzen 7 5800X is two hundred sixteen euros for nearly the same eight cores.
The Ryzen 7 7700X is only two hundred fifty euros, but it needs a separate cooler.
The 5800XT costs two hundred eighty-one euros, a slightly faster 5800X for more money.
The Ryzen 7 9700X is two hundred ninety-nine euros, efficient but with no extra cache.
The Ryzen 7 7700 costs three hundred twenty-one euros, mostly for the included cooler.
The Ryzen 7 7800X3D is three hundred thirty-six euros, the best gaming value today.
And the price that makes no sense: the old 5800X3D costs three hundred sixty-four euros, more than the 7800X3D.
The Ryzen 7 9800X3D is four hundred forty-four euros, the fastest chip here.
The pattern is simple: for games, cache beats cores. And old chips can cost more than new ones.
Follow for more prices. Which would you buy, 7800X3D or 9800X3D?
